## Requirements (contract §In-scope)

1. ADR-0363 — `live-executed` evidence class: definition + never-means,
   `hh-live-evidence/1` record format, redaction rule, cumulative $100
   spend ledger + stop-and-ask, live-test gating convention, response-header
   allowlist (request ids etc.), console-billing authority note.
2. `docs/build/reports/live/` — `SPEND.jsonl` (append-only) + `pricing.json`
   (per-model rates + source + date; local = 0) + per-ticket allocation
   table (R4.5d 5 · R4.5e 5 · R4.6 15 · R4.7b 5 · R4.7e 15 · L4.6 30 ·
   reserve 25; others 0).
3. `scripts/live-verify.sh <leg> [--budget USD]` — sources live.env without
   echo/`set -x`; missing NAME → exit 4 (HUMAN-H6); over-budget → exit 3
   "SPEND CAP — ask the operator"; runs leg; leak-detectors (CC1 —
   `hh-secrets` `leak_scan` via a thin `hh-secret-scan` bin) over every
   artifact before write; writes record + spend entry. `--check-names
   [<leg>|--all]` prints NAME → provided: yes/no only.
4. Gating convention — live tests `#[ignore = "live — ADR-0363:
   scripts/live-verify.sh <leg>"]`; AGENTS.md ignore-rule amended.
5. Evidence validator `crates/hh-telemetry/tests/live_evidence.rs` —
   parses every committed record vs `hh-live-evidence/1`, spend sums ≤ 100,
   every record's spend entry exists; invariants only (BM-TEST-01).
6. Proof leg `local-reachability` — GET OpenAI-compatible model listing at
   HH_LOCAL_BASE_URL; assert HH_LOCAL_MODEL served; committed record USD 0.
7. AGENTS.md gotcha 5 re-worded (`live-executed` permitted only with cited
   record); OPERATIONAL_READINESS legend gains the class.
8. `.gitleaks.toml` committed — the 7 fake-fixture `generic-api-key` hits
   allowlisted by path+rule with reasons; `live-verify.sh` runs
   `gitleaks git --staged --redact` over the staged diff before any
   evidence commit; any finding refuses + STOPS-and-asks.

Out of scope: model calls through the kernel (R4.5b); TLS (R4.5c); the
GitHub Actions live workflow (L4.3 — reuses this `.gitleaks.toml`).

## Plan

baseline already run) → ADR-0363 (the contract's anchor: class, record
format, redaction, spend mechanics, gating, header allowlist, homes) →

artifact scan-before-write, gitleaks staged gate, record+spend write) →
`scripts/ci/test-live-verify.sh` (hermetic script test, wired into the

ignore-rule amendment → OPERATIONAL_READINESS legend → live run of the
`local-reachability` leg (Ollama LISTEN on 127.0.0.1:11434 — executable)
→ `adr-index` regen.

Verification targets: `cargo build/test/clippy -p hh-secrets` (the one

no schema change), `check-ci-gating.sh` (ci.yml edited), the new
self-test + validator, gitleaks baseline + staged gate, `check-build-memory.sh`.
